name: antigravity-aistudio
description: Cloud offloading and workflow automation for Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/) through Antigravity's built-in browser subagent. Offload reasoning, 1M-token context analysis, prompt engineering, few-shot tuning, Thinking level (High/XHigh) calibration, and SDK code export to conserve Antigravity desktop app quota.
suggestedPrompts: Analyze a large multi-file codebase architecture by offloading 1M-token context to Google AI Studio with Gemini 4 Neon (High)
Construct and evaluate a few-shot structured prompt with JSON response schema in Google AI Studio
Tune Gemini 4 Thinking level (High), Output length, URL context, and safety settings in Google AI Studio, then export production Python code
Audit live Google AI Studio web UI capabilities and Gemini 4 model availability with aistudio-ui-sync-audit
